name: Chick'n Mushroom Soup
source:
Chick’n Mushroom Soup is an anime styled Visual Novel which you've been accepted into a culinary academy with sweet girls. Although you were a total asocial in the past, you now have an opportunity to change this.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771590/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Chick'n Mushroom Soup》是一部動漫風格的視覺小說。你被烹飪學院錄取，身邊還有一群可愛的女孩。過去的你完全不與人交往，現在卻有了改變的機會。

［取自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771590/]Steam[/url]］
